rule: Hard rule 7 (Ahmad): the bit-KB must live on Ahmad's machine at a known location.
refresh: Run scripts/kb-pull.mjs (daily Task Scheduler job recommended).
reverify: aria-reverify re-checks freshness on the 1st & 15th and re-queues stale topics.
note: Serverless functions cannot write to the local disk; the loop writes to the aria-kb-live blob store and the puller mirrors it here so Ahmad owns a versioned local copy.
